title: Triple Pose Female Warrior
description: Three sequential views of a young woman with short buzzed hair and facial scars against a solid black background. She wears a brown and black armored top with exposed midriff, blue pants with red stripes and knee pads, and heavy boots. The left panel shows her in a defensive stance with arms crossed as a white energy burst explodes from her wrists. The center panel captures her mid-leap in a dynamic running pose. The right panel shows her in an aggressive forward stance with glowing orange energy emanating from her boots.
prompt: A triptych of a tough young woman with a shaved head, facial scars, and intense expression, shown in three different action poses against a pure black background. She wears a cropped brown and black tactical top exposing her midriff, blue jeans with red vertical stripes, brown knee pads, fingerless gloves, and heavy brown boots. Left panel shows her blocking with crossed arms as white energy bursts from her wrists. Center panel shows her leaping forward dynamically. Right panel shows her charging with fire trailing from her boots. Cinematic lighting, detailed textures, gritty realistic digital painting style.
